subject: literacy
concept: Identifying an author's central claim in an informational text
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student sorts sentence cards from an article into 'central claim' and 'supporting detail' piles
exercise.pictorial: Student circles the sentence that best states an article's central claim
exercise.abstract: Student states the central claim of a given informational text in their own words

misconception_flags: names a specific supporting detail rather than the article's actual overarching claim

interest_binding: passage content generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
